race.description: Kristen Doyle WTC Thanks You For 15 Years Hcp (C2)
race.comment: ARTIE VAINQUEUR (12) built on a nice third when fresh from a spell two starts back at Toowoomba with a win as public elect over 1350m at this track two weeks ago, getting home by 2.5 lengths. Will have derived some confidence from that victory and is likely to be in the finish again. I'M NELSON (6) strips fitter second-up from the break and is one from one over this course and distance. In the mix from the inside alley. MR BUBBALUSKI (2) has placed two from two over this trip and must be respected out of the Bruce camp. Top-three commodity. SOMETHIN IN ORANGE (10) rounds out the selections in a race decimated by scratchings.
